question: I'm doing my capstone in international politics. Which professors research or teach that, and who should I ask to be my advisor?

[2]

Based on those profiles, ask Dean Chen whether he can advise your capstone; I can’t verify capstone-advisor eligibility or availability. question: Hi, I need a faculty mentor for an independent study on machine learning in healthcare. Who in the nursing or science school does that kind of research, and how do I contact them?
answer:
Patrick Mattis, Associate Professor of Nursing in the School of Science, Nursing, and Health, is the closest documented match: his research interests include “Clinical Informatics and Decision Support,” “Healthcare Data Analytics,” and other health-informatics topics. The profile does not specifically mention machine learning. Contact him at pmattis@ramapo.edu or (201) 684-7143; office AC-213. Office hours: via WebEx by appointment. [4]

For the independent study process, the catalog says to obtain an Independent Study Registration Form from the Registrar, have the instructor and dean of the sponsoring school complete it, then return it to the Registrar’s Office. Graduate studies also require the graduate program director’s completion. Students must also complete an Independent Study contract form. Undergraduate students may take no more than FOUR (4) credits in a semester and normally may not exceed eight over their career; graduate students may take up to six credits toward graduation with program director permission. Students on academic probation or warning need the Dean’s permission; independent study cannot be for a course offered in the regular schedule, and registration is not accepted after the last day of add/drop. [8]

Sources: [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/snh/faculty/patrick-mattis/) [8](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#independent-study1)
